text.en:
On Barricade Placement:
Generates a Healing Pulse, instantly healing the user and allies within 12 metres.

Healing Pulse heals for either 58 HP OR to 130HP. 
The Healing Pulse heals for whichever value restores the most HP.

Requires Line-of-Sight to allies.

Super Abilities generate an extra Orb of Power.
text.ko:
방벽 시전 시:
플레이어와 12미터 이내의 아군을 치유하는 치유의 파동을 일으킵니다.
치유의 파동은 58 - 130HP를 회복시킵니다.
아군이 효과를 받기 위해선 시전자의 시선 안에 있어야 합니다.

궁극기가 힘의 보주 하나를 추가로 생성합니다.
text.zh-chs:
当你释放屏障时：
会产生一个治疗脉冲，瞬间治愈你和 12 米范围内的盟友。

治疗脉冲治疗 58 点生命值，或者恢复至 130 点生命值。
取恢复血量更多的那个值。

需要对友军有直线视线。

超能会产生额外一个能量球。

text.en:
Casting your Barricade emits a Healing Pulse:
Heals the wearer and allies within 12 meters if they have line of sight to the wearer.

Healing Pulse heals either FOR 58 HP or TO 130 HP, whichever option restores the more health.

Super Abilities generate an extra Orb of Power that grants 7.14% Super Energy (regular Super Orb).

Specific Interactions:
• Roaming Supers start generating Orbs after just 1 Kill instead of needing at least 2
• Ward of Dawn generates 4 Orbs with each granting 3.57% Super Energy (up from 3 Orbs granting 2.3% each for a ~2x increase)

5 second cooldown between activations.

Specific Interactions:

• <void/>Ward of Dawn generates 4 Orbs with each granting 3.57% Super Energy (up from 3 Orbs granting 2.3% each for a ~2x increase)

Class Ability usage heals you and allies within 12 meters as long as they have line of sight to you.

Casting a Barricade restores 80 Health and 75 Shield HP. Using <arc/>Thruster restores 60 Health.

Scoring multiple Direct Hits within 3 seconds of each while behind a Barricade triggers an additional healing pulse that restores 30 HP in a 12 meter radius.

Activation progress granted by weapon type:
• Submachine Guns, Trace Rifles: 7.14%
• Auto Rifles, Machine Guns: 8.33%
• Pulse Rifles: 9.1%
• Sidearms: 12.5%
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 16.7%
• Swords: 20% 
• Bows, Glaives, Grenade Launchers, Shotguns, Sniper Rifles: 34%

Additional hits provide no activation progress for 2 seconds after a Healing Pulse is triggered. 5 second cooldown between healing pulse activations. (why are these separate)
